Who is the iENYRID M4 Pro S+ for? It’s engineered for adult riders who want a powerful off-road electric scooter with a removable seat, an industry-leading 330 lbs weight capacity, a large color LCD display, and full suspension — all in a foldable, commuter-ready package under $500.

⚡ Key Specs at a Glance

  • Motor: 800W
  • Top Speed: 28 mph (45 km/h)
  • Range: 20–25 miles per charge
  • Battery: 48V 12.5Ah lithium-ion
  • Charge Time: 6–8 hours
  • Max Load: 330 lbs — heavy-duty capacity
  • Seat: Removable saddle seat (included)
  • Tires: 10-inch off-road pneumatic (inflatable)
  • Brakes: Front & rear disc brakes + E-ABS electronic braking
  • Suspension: Front & rear dual shock absorption (full suspension)
  • Display: Large central color LCD
  • Frame: Aluminum alloy
  • Foldable: Yes — quick-fold design
  • Warranty: 1-year limited warranty

1. Electric Scooter with Removable Seat — Ride Standing or Seated

The M4 Pro S+ is one of the few foldable electric scooters that includes a removable saddle seat as standard. Ride standing for agility on short urban trips, or attach the seat for comfortable long-distance commutes and leisure rides. The versatile dual-mode design makes it ideal for riders of all preferences.

2. 330 lbs Max Load — Heavy-Duty Electric Scooter for Adults

With a 330 lbs (150 kg) maximum weight capacity, the M4 Pro S+ is one of the highest-capacity electric scooters in its class. The robust aluminum alloy frame and reinforced components ensure stability and durability for heavier riders without compromising performance.

3. 800W Motor — 28 MPH Off-Road Performance

The 800W motor delivers a top speed of 28 mph with strong torque for hill climbing and off-road terrain. Whether navigating city streets, gravel paths, grass, or light trails, the M4 Pro S+ handles every surface with confidence.

4. 20–25 Mile Range — Long-Distance Battery

The 48V 12.5Ah lithium-ion battery provides a practical range of 20–25 miles per charge — enough for most daily commutes and errands. Recharge in 6–8 hours overnight and you’re ready for the next day.

5. Large Color LCD Display — Clear Visibility at a Glance

The upgraded large central color LCD dashboard displays real-time speed, battery level, gear position, and riding mode in a clear, easy-to-read format. Centrally mounted to minimize damage risk and maximize rider visibility compared to side-mounted displays.

6. Full Dual Suspension + 10" Off-Road Tires — Smooth on Any Terrain

A front and rear shock absorption system combined with 10-inch inflatable off-road pneumatic tires absorbs bumps, curbs, and rough terrain. The result is a stable, comfortable ride whether you’re commuting on asphalt or exploring gravel trails.

7. Dual Disc Brakes + E-ABS — Maximum Stopping Power

The M4 Pro S+ features front and rear mechanical disc brakes combined with E-ABS electronic braking for fast, controlled stops in any emergency. Night riding is covered by high-brightness LED off-road headlights, handlebar turn signals, and a rear taillight.

8. Adjustable Handlebar + Quick-Fold Design — Fits Every Rider

The adjustable handlebar height accommodates riders of different heights for a comfortable, ergonomic posture. The quick-fold mechanism lets you collapse the scooter in seconds for easy storage at home, under a desk, or in a car trunk.

9. 1-Year Limited Warranty + Support

Every iENYRID M4 Pro S+ includes a 1-year limited warranty. For questions or support, contact support@ienyrid.com.

A: Up to 28 mph (45 km/h).

Q: How far can the M4 Pro S+ travel on one charge?
A: 20–25 miles under optimal conditions with the 48V 12.5Ah battery.

Q: Is the M4 Pro S+ good for off-road riding?
A: Yes. The 10-inch pneumatic off-road tires and front & rear dual suspension handle grass, gravel, mud, and light trails comfortably.

Q: What braking system does the M4 Pro S+ use?
A: Front and rear mechanical disc brakes combined with E-ABS electronic braking for maximum stopping power.

Q: Is the M4 Pro S+ foldable?
A: Yes. It features a quick-fold mechanism for easy storage and transport.

Q: Does the M4 Pro S+ come with a warranty?

Front and rear 10-inch tubeless vacuum tires eliminate the risk of sudden blowouts that plague tube-type scooters. A: Yes. The H3 features a 3-speed gear system that lets parents limit speed for younger riders, a chest protection bar, dual hydraulic brakes, IPX4 water resistance, and fault code alerts — making it one of the safest high-performance electric dirt bikes for teens.

Q: Is the VIPCOO H3 suitable for beginners?
A: Yes. Gear 1 provides a low-speed, manageable riding experience ideal for beginners and younger teens. Riders can progress to Gear 2 and Gear 3 as their confidence and skills grow.

Q: Is the H3 waterproof?
A: The H3 carries an IPX4 water resistance rating, making it reliable in rain and wet conditions.

Q: What is the maximum weight capacity?
A: 265 lbs (120 kg).
